annotations.title: Discover deals for the shopper's interests

description: Deal browsing with no store or product named (categories, interests, gift ideas, "what's on sale"). A named product or brand: find_product_coupons; a named store: find_coupons. Pass interests (non-sensitive) with quick: true, several categories in parallel, one quick call each; a named store: store alone. Never mix the two. Present a short curated edit with each pick's match_reason.

category.description: Optional: the product's category in McClipFace's taxonomy, so results stay in it inferred from what the shopper means, never from a keyword (honey for the pantry: grocery; honey face wash: beauty); omit when unsure. One of: 3d-printing, asian-fashion, audio, auto, baby-gear, bags, beauty, bedding, building-sets, bullion, camera-lenses, cameras, camping-hiking, cat-supplies, christmas-decor, cleaning, computer-components, computers, cycling, dog-supplies, drones, easter-decor, education, electronics, eyewear, fashion, fitness-gear, footwear, fourth-of-july-decor, fragrance, furniture, games-puzzles, gaming, garden, gifts-food, golf, grocery, grooming, haircare, halloween-decor, headphones-earbuds, health, holiday-decor, home, home-decor, home-improvement, household-essentials, j-beauty, japanese-fashion, jewelry, k-beauty, kids-clothing, kitchen, korean-fashion, makeup, marketplace, microphones-studio, networking, office-supplies, oral-care, otc-medicine, outdoor-play, outerwear, party-supplies, personal-care, pets, phones, photo-editing, photo-printing, photography, printers, skincare, smart-home, software, speakers-home-audio, sports-outdoors, thanksgiving-decor, toys, toys-kids, travel, turntables-hifi, tvs-home-theater, valentines-decor, video-gear, wearables. A close name is mapped to the nearest one; an unknown one is ignored.

client.description: Optional: your app or partner name (a short label, no key), used only to count clicks.

client_platform.description: Required: the app you (the AI) are running in, as one lowercase word, e.g. chatgpt, claude, grok. A lookup without it is rejected with platform_required; resend it with this field.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase (default USD). Only offers in this currency are returned (USD leaves out non-US stores).

general.description: True for the general selection (no search terms).

keywords.description: Products, brands or interests, e.g. ["Sony camera"]. Leave out categories and keywords for general deals.

limit.description: Number of deals, 1-20 (default 10); one store's deals, 1-100 (default 25).

quick.description: True for a fast answer in seconds: the most promising deals only. Use it when browsing or for one category of several.

store.description: Optional: a named store's current deals (send it alone, no search terms).

name: discover_deals
title: Discover deals for the shopper's interests
